# Data Preparation

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, results = "hide", fig.show = "hide", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, include = TRUE, eval = FALSE)
```

## Packages

```{r Load Packages}
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(misty)
library(apaTables)
library(jtools)
library(interactions)
library(sandwich)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(brms)
library(sjPlot)
library(lavaan)
```

## Dataset

```{r Read Dataset}
dataset <- read.csv("dataset.csv")
```

```{r Delete first rows of data with NA on all values}

dataset <- dataset[-(1:5),]
```

```{r Subset sample to White British who passed attention check}
mydf <- subset(loose, Ethnicity == 1 & Attention == 2)
```

```{r Create integer vectors}

mydf <- as.data.frame(apply(mydf, 2, as.integer))

```

```{r Data Cleaning}
mydf$Gender <- car::recode(mydf$Gender, "1 = '0' ; 2 = '1'") 

mydf$Gender<-item.reverse(mydf$Gender, min = 0, max = 1)

mydf$SDO_9.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_9, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_10.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_10, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_11.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_11, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_12.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_12, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_13.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_13, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_14.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_14, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_15.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_15, min = 1, max = 5)
mydf$SDO_16.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SDO_16, min = 1, max = 5)

mydf$Nat_8.r <- item.reverse(mydf$Nat_8, min = 1, max = 5)

mydf$SelfEsteem_7.r <- item.reverse(mydf$SelfEsteem_7, min = 1, max = 4)

mydf<-mydf[!(mydf$Gender=="3" ),]

mydf<-mydf[!(mydf$Income =="0" ),]

mydf$logIncome <- log(mydf$Income)

mydf$IRD <- mydf$SelfEsteem_7.r

mydf$Natmean <- (mydf$Nat_1+mydf$Nat_2+mydf$Nat_3+mydf$Nat_4+mydf$Nat_5+mydf$Nat_6+mydf$Nat_7+mydf$Nat_8.r)/8

mydf$SDOmean <- (mydf$SDO_1+mydf$SDO_2+mydf$SDO_3+mydf$SDO_4+mydf$SDO_5+mydf$SDO_6+mydf$SDO_7+mydf$SDO_8+mydf$SDO_9.r+mydf$SDO_10.r+mydf$SDO_11.r+mydf$SDO_12.r+mydf$SDO_13.r+mydf$SDO_14.r+mydf$SDO_15.r+mydf$SDO_16.r)/16

mydf$GRDmean <- (mydf$GRD_1+mydf$GRD_2)/2

mydf$IDmean <- (mydf$NatIden_1+mydf$NatIden_2+mydf$NatIden_3)/3

mydf$Ethmean <- (mydf$EthIden_1+mydf$EthIden_2+mydf$EthIden_3)/3
```

## Demographics

```{r Percentage Secondary school education}
category_counts <- table(mydf$Education)

category_percentages <- prop.table(category_counts) * 100

category_percentages
```

```{r Dichotimize education variable}
mydf$Education_d <- car::recode(mydf$Education, "1:4 = '0'; 5:7 = '1'")
```

## Reliability of Scales

```{r Reliability GRD}
cor.test(mydf$GRD_1, mydf$GRD_2, method=c("pearson"))
```

```{r Reliability Nationalism}
items_Nat <- c("Nat_1","Nat_2", "Nat_3", "Nat_4", "Nat_5", "Nat_6", "Nat_7", "Nat_8")
mydf[items_Nat]
psych::alpha(mydf[items_Nat])
```

```{r Reliability SDO}
items_SDO <- c("SDO_1","SDO_2", "SDO_3", "SDO_4", "SDO_5", "SDO_6", "SDO_7", "SDO_8","SDO_9.r","SDO_10.r","SDO_11.r","SDO_12.r",
"SDO_13.r", "SDO_14.r","SDO_15.r","SDO_16.r")
mydf[items_SDO]
psych::alpha(mydf[items_SDO])
```

```{r National ID}
items_NatIden <- c("NatIden_1","NatIden_2", "NatIden_3")
mydf[items_NatIden]
psych::alpha(mydf[items_NatIden])
```

## Mean Centering

```{r Mean Centering}
mydf$GRD.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRDmean, scale = F))
mydf$GRD1.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD_1, scale = F))
mydf$GRD2.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD_2, scale = F))
mydf$SDO.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$SDOmean, scale =F))
mydf$Natmean.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Natmean, scale = F))
mydf$IDmean.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$IDmean, scale = F))
mydf$Age.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Age, scale = F))
mydf$Gender.m = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Gender, scale = F))
```

## Standardization

```{r Standardization}
mydf$GRD_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRDmean, scale = T))
mydf$GRD1_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD_1, scale = T))
mydf$GRD2_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$GRD_2, scale = T))
mydf$SDO_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$SDOmean, scale =T))
mydf$Natmean_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Natmean, scale = T))
mydf$IDmean_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$IDmean, scale = T))
mydf$Age_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Age, scale = T))
mydf$Gender_std = as.numeric(scale(mydf$Gender, scale = T))
```

## Create Correlation Table

```{r Correlation Table}
loosetable <- select(mydf, Natmean , GRD_1 , GRD_2 , SDOmean , Ethmean , Age , Gender)

apa.cor.table(loosetable,
              filename = "loosetable.doc",
              table.number = 1,
              show.sig.stars = TRUE,
              landscape = FALSE
)
```

# GRD Full Models

## GRD Full Model

```{r Path Model GRDmean}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD.m*mydf$SDO.m

model1 <- '
# regressions
Natmean ~ b1*GRD.m + b2*SDO.m + b3*int
IDmean ~ GRD.m + SDO.m + int

# residual covariance of DVs
Natmean ~~ IDmean

# Simple Slopes

SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.7
SDOMed := b1+b3*0
SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.7)
'

fit1 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit1, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)
```

## GRD Full Model Standardised

```{r Path Model GRDmean Standardized Effect Sizes}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD.m*mydf$SDO.m

model1.1 <- '
# regressions
Natmean_std ~ b1*GRD_std + b2*SDO_std + b3*int
IDmean_std ~ b4*GRD_std + b5*SDO_std + b6*int

# residual covariance of DVs
Natmean_std ~~ IDmean_std

# Simple Slopes

N_SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.7
N_SDOMed := b1+b3*0
N_SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.7)

# Simple Slopes Patriotism

P_SDOHigh := b4+b6*0.7
P_SDOMed := b4+b6*0
P_SDOLow := b4+b6*(-0.7)
'

fit1.1 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1.1, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1.1, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit1.1, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)
```

```{r Path Model GRDmean w/ covariates}

model1.2 <- '

Natmean ~ b1*GRD.m + b2*SDO.m + b3*int + Age + Gender
IDmean ~ GRD.m + SDO.m + int  + Age + Gender

# residual covariance of DVs
Natmean ~~ IDmean

# Simple Slopes

SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.7
SDOMed := b1+b3*0
SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.7)
'

fit1.2 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1.2, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1.2, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit1.2, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)

```

## GRD Full Model Standardised w/ Covariates

```{r Path Model GRDmean w/ covariates standardised}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD.m*mydf$SDO.m

model1.3 <- '
# regressions
Natmean_std ~ b1*GRD_std + b2*SDO_std + b3*int + Age_std + Gender_std
IDmean_std ~ GRD_std + SDO_std + int + Age_std + Gender_std

# residual covariance of DVs
Natmean_std ~~ IDmean_std

# Simple Slopes

SDOMed := b1+b3*0
SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.7)
'

fit1.3 <- lavaan::sem(model = model1.3, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit1.3, fit.measures=TRUE)
```

## GRD Full Model Visualisation

```{r Visualisation Simple Slopes GRD Full Model}
mydf <- mydf %>%
  filter(!is.na(GRDmean) & !is.na(SDOmean) & !is.na(Natmean))

model1 <- lm(data = mydf, Natmean ~  GRDmean*SDOmean)


object1 <- sjPlot::plot_model(model1, type = "int", 
                             terms = c("GRDmean", "SDOmean[mean(SDOmean, na.rm = TRUE) - sd(SDOmean, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     mean(SDOmean, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     mean(SDOmean, na.rm = TRUE) + sd(SDOmean, na.rm = TRUE)]")+
labs(x = "GRDmean") +
labs(y = "Natmean") +
labs(color = "SDOmean"))


tiff("Figure2.tiff", units="in", width=7, height=5, res=300, type = "cairo")

# Create the plot

plot <- object1 +
  # Confidence interval ribbons with transparency
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  
  # Add lines with different linetypes based on group (SDO levels)
  geom_line(aes(linetype = group), size = 1.3) +
  
  # Customize the color scheme and linetypes
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#002C54", "#C5001A"), labels = c("Low SDO (-1 SD)", "High SDO (+1 SD)")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#002C54", "#C5001A")) +
  
  # Add linetype for the dotted line (e.g., "dashed" or "dotted")
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dotted"), labels = c("Low SDO (-1 SD)", "High SDO (+1 SD)")) +
  
  # Set x-axis limits from 1 to 4
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 4), breaks = seq(1, 4, 1)) +
  
  # Set y-axis limits to start at 2, and ensure it shows only whole numbers
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 7), breaks = seq(1, 7, 1)) +
  
  # Add labels for axes and legend
  labs(x = "GRD", y = "Nationalism", color = "SDO", linetype = "SDO", fill = "Confidence Interval", 
       title = NULL) +
  
  # Customize the theme
  theme_apa() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.185, 0.84),  # Adjust legend position inside plot
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0))
  )

# Display the plot
plot

# Close the TIFF file
dev.off()
```

# Affective GRD Models

## GRD1 Model

```{r Path Model GRD01}

mydf$int <- mydf$GRD1.m*mydf$SDO.m

model2 <- '
# regressions
Natmean ~ b1*GRD1.m + b2*SDO.m + b3*int
IDmean ~ GRD1.m + SDO.m + int

# residual covariance of DVs
Natmean ~~ IDmean

# Simple Slopes

SDOHigh := b1+b3*0.7
SDOMed := b1+b3*0
SDOLow := b1+b3*(-0.7)
'

fit2 <- lavaan::sem(model = model2, data = mydf, fixed.x = FALSE,
                    meanstructure = TRUE)
summary(fit2, fit.measures=TRUE)

parameter_estimates <- parameterEstimates(fit2, ci = TRUE)
print(parameter_estimates)

```
